subject: Dev Sandbox credit request — triage and issuance
messages:
From: Ari Torres <ari@cloudforge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-10T09:14:23-07:00
Subject: Requesting sandbox credits for Dev team (CloudForge)

Hi Marcus,

We just signed up a handful of engineers to evaluate Redwood for our developer sandbox (CloudForge). We hit the self-serve token limit yesterday while stress-testing batching and can't continue validation for a feature demo next week. Is there a way to get a small top-up (20k–50k tokens) or a temporary trial extension?

Customer details:
- Company: CloudForge
- Org domain: @cloudforge.ai
- Use case: local dev sandbox + integration smoke tests (non-prod)
- Expected monthly spend if successful: ~$4k

I attached a screenshot of our usage chart. Appreciate any quick help — demo scheduled for Wed 9/17.

Thanks,
Ari Torres
Director of Developer Experience
CloudForge

Attachment: cloudforge-usage-20250910.png

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Torres <ari@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-10T09:46:02-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting sandbox credits for Dev team (CloudForge)

Hi Ari — thanks for the details and the quick heads-up.

We can usually help with a one-time sandbox top-up to keep demos moving while you evaluate. Two quick asks so I can expedite:
1) Can you confirm the HubSpot or account email you used to sign up (so I can find the org record)?
2) Are engineers hitting the per-minute streaming rate limit or total monthly tokens? The screenshot helps but I want to be precise.

If you prefer, I can provision an initial 30k token credit and we can extend after the demo depending on usage. Ben (cc'd) will help with the account lookup and issuance flow.

I can also provide a temporary API key policy to separate sandbox usage if that helps.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Growth — Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — signed up with ari@cloudforge.ai (same as this email). The screenshot was total monthly tokens; engineers are mostly hitting the monthly cap, not streaming rate. Happy with 30k to start.

If you need a short attestation for compliance (we're security-sensitive), I can provide the non-prod environment details.

—Ari

Hi Ari — quick note to confirm the credit is live.

- 30,000 token sandbox credit has been applied to ari@cloudforge.ai (expires 2025-10-10).
- We created a sandbox API key policy scoped to non-prod endpoints; see: https://docs.redwood.inference/quickstarts/sandbox-usage

If you hit the cap again before your demo, reply to this thread and I'll escalate to a short-term boost. Otherwise, if the evaluation looks promising we can discuss reserved capacity discounts and a pilot.

Good luck with the demo next week — let us know if you'd like Redwood on the call for technical Q&A.

Best,
